run_pump_generator: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate repetitive C++ boilerplate code
create_pump_template: create a .pump template file with $var, $for, $range directives to generate parameterized code
parse_pump_ast: parse Pump source text into an AST using ParseToAST for programmatic code generation analysis
convert_pump_source: convert Pump source text to generated output using ConvertFromPumpSource with variable expansion and loops
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated C++ code by wrapping long lines to 80 characters using BeautifyCode
